rules.text: Each house also describes relatives, counted from the house that stands for them (3rd younger sibling, 4th mother, 5th children, 7th partner, 9th father, 11th elder sibling). So a house can be good for the native and bad for a relative.
The 12th house counted from any house works against that house. So the 3rd (12th from the 4th) shows a change of residence, and the 11th (12th from the 12th) shows discharge from hospital.
The Moon is in Pisces, the 9th sign (a trine) from its own sign. Krishnamurti holds that this placing strengthens the Moon in giving the matters of the house it rules.
Mars is in Pisces, the 12th sign from its own Aries. Krishnamurti holds that Mars is then weak at giving the matters of the house whose cusp falls in Aries.
The Sun is in Pisces, the 8th sign from its own Leo. Krishnamurti holds that the Sun is then weak at giving the matters of the house it rules.
Jupiter rules the 6th or 8th for this Venus-ruled ascendant. This lordship, not myth, is why tradition calls Jupiter an enemy of Venus: Jupiter brings the matters of those houses.
Venus rules the 6th or 8th for this Jupiter-ruled ascendant. This lordship, not myth, is why tradition calls Venus an enemy of Jupiter: Venus brings the matters of those houses.
Mars rules the 6th or 8th for this Mercury-ruled ascendant. This lordship, not myth, is why tradition calls Mars an enemy of Mercury: Mars brings the matters of those houses.
Mercury rules the 6th or 8th for this Mars-ruled ascendant. This lordship, not myth, is why tradition calls Mercury an enemy of Mars: Mercury brings the matters of those houses.
No house is bad in itself. The 6th, 8th and 12th are called evil houses, but a house spoils its matters only when it is afflicted; benefics in a house improve it and malefics harm it.

A planet gives above all the results of its star lord: what the star lord offers by the houses it occupies and owns comes through the planets in its stars. For a planet in the 12th, its star lord’s houses matter more than the 12th itself.
There are planets in the 11th. Krishnamurti says planets in the 11th invariably do good: of all houses it is the most favourable for fulfilling desires.
Saturn is in the 11th, which Krishnamurti calls very good. A benefic Saturn here gives its results in its own sub period and holds them back in the sub periods before it.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: Saturn is in the 12th, a placing Krishnamurti calls very unfavourable (the story of Indrajit’s birth): it brings pride and a fall.
Mercury is joined with or aspected by Jupiter or Venus. Mercury takes on the nature of the planets it is linked with, so here it leans to the benefic side.
Mercury is joined with or aspected by a malefic (Saturn, Mars or a node). Mercury takes on the nature of the planets it is linked with, so here it leans to the malefic side.
Opposite promises in one chart do not cancel out. Each planet gives what it shows in its own periods and sub periods, so the good and the bad side of one matter can both come, at different times.
An afflicted house gives its bad results only in the periods of the planet that afflicts it. In the periods of a planet well linked to that house, its matters improve.
The result of a link between two planets comes when the native runs their joint periods (the dasa, bhukti or anthra of one within the other), not at other times.
Rahu is in the star of a lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th. Krishnamurti says such a Rahu gives unwelcome results in its periods, even from a house that is otherwise counted as helpful.
Rahu is joined with or aspected by a lord of the 2nd, 6th or 10th, and its star lord signifies these houses: Rahu points to the profession, and service tends to begin in its sub period.
Ketu is joined with or aspected by a lord of the 2nd, 6th or 10th, and its star lord signifies these houses: Ketu points to the profession, and service tends to begin in its sub period.
A lord of, or a planet in, the 2nd, 7th or 11th aspects Rahu, and Rahu’s star lord signifies these houses: Rahu becomes an indicator of marriage, which tends to be celebrated in its sub period.
A lord of, or a planet in, the 2nd, 7th or 11th aspects Ketu, and Ketu’s star lord signifies these houses: Ketu becomes an indicator of marriage, which tends to be celebrated in its sub period.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Rahu in the 2nd or 7th is joined with or aspected by a lord of the 5th or 9th. Such a node increases wealth and wellbeing in its periods.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Rahu in a dual sign is joined with a lord of the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th. It brings wealth and influence in its periods.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Rahu in a dual sign is joined with a lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th. Its periods bring little benefit.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Ketu in the 2nd or 7th is joined with or aspected by a lord of the 5th or 9th. Such a node increases wealth and wellbeing in its periods.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Ketu in a dual sign is joined with a lord of the 1st, 4th, 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th. It brings wealth and influence in its periods.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Ketu in a dual sign is joined with a lord of the 6th, 8th or 12th. Its periods bring little benefit.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: A planet in the 12th also signifies the 2nd, 6th and 10th: service in a hospital or a similar institution is indicated.
Tradition holds that the 4th, or the 10th, shows the father; Krishnamurti rejects this because the 4th belongs to the mother. Always read the father from the 9th and the mother from the 4th.

Count every third house for the order of births. The 5th is the first child, the 7th the second, the 9th the third. Likewise the 3rd is the first younger sibling, the 5th the next and the 7th the third; the 11th is the elder sibling.
A benefic (Jupiter or Venus) or the Moon is in the 5th house, which adds to the strength and number of children.
The lord of the 3rd sits in the 2nd, 6th or 10th, linking the 3rd with work and money: agency, commission business, broking, representing others or publicity suit the native.

Pair a house with its karaka when timing: land comes in the joint periods of a significator of the 4th and Mars, a vehicle in those of the 4th and Venus, and matters of the mother in those of the 4th and the Moon.
A benefic is in the 6th, or the 6th lord is joined with Jupiter or Venus. The native succeeds in raising loans when needed.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The lord of the 4th is in the 12th: a change of residence, or a thorough change of surroundings.

rules.topic: Expenses, residence abroad and spiritual life
rules.text: The 9th is linked with the 12th (the 9th lord in the 12th, or joined with the 12th lord, or a planet in the 12th in the 9th lord’s star): a clear sign of long journeys and life in a distant place.

Other house groups: success in efforts 1, 10, 11; contests are won through the 11th, the 7th being the rival; a lover is seen from the 11th, the legal bond from the 7th; open enemies from the 6th and secret ones from the 12th, not the 7th.
With Libra rising, Saturn rules both a kendra and a trine, so it becomes a benefic by lordship and promises lasting, grand success.
With Taurus rising, Saturn rules the 9th and the 10th, the most favourable houses, and so becomes a strong benefic (yogakaraka) for this chart.
With Libra rising, Venus rules both the 1st and the 8th. As lagna lord it protects, but as 8th lord it throws up obstacles, so Venus does not give a smooth life.
The ascendant is in a sign of Venus (Taurus or Libra). Saturn is very favourable for such natives.
The ascendant is in a sign of Mercury (Gemini or Virgo). Krishnamurti counts Saturn as evil for such natives.
With Taurus rising, Mercury rules both the 2nd and the 5th: a taste for speculation and games of chance, with gains in Mercury’s periods.
With Taurus rising, Mars rules both the 7th and the 12th; Krishnamurti reads this as a partner who is not already a relative.
With Libra rising, Jupiter rules both the 3rd and the 6th, so younger siblings and neighbours tend to be unfriendly.
With Libra rising and Mars ruling the 2nd and the 7th, the partner tends to be of the Martian type: active, frank and quick-tempered.
With Libra rising and the Sun ruling the 11th, friends come from among Government servants and officials.
With Scorpio rising, Jupiter rules both the 2nd and the 5th, which favours gains from speculation.
With Scorpio rising, the lords of the 2nd, 7th and 11th (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) are all benefics: married life goes well unless malefics occupy or aspect these houses.
With Scorpio rising, Mercury rules both the 8th and the 11th: friends may let the native down or bring discredit, so choose them with care.
With Sagittarius rising, the 9th and 10th lords, the Sun and Mercury, are together (Nipuna yoga): a quick grasp and a retentive mind.
With Sagittarius rising, Mars rules both the 5th and the 12th, so speculation does not pay.
The lord of the 6th also rules the 11th (Venus for Sagittarius rising, Mars for Gemini rising): a quarrel often turns into lasting friendship, especially in that planet’s sub periods.

With Sagittarius rising, a lord of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 6th or 11th sits in Poorvashada (Venus’s star in Sagittarius). Krishnamurti says such natives grow rich quickly, with gains that come without much pain.
With Capricorn rising, Mars rules both the 4th and the 11th: benefits come through the mother, and co-tenants cooperate.
With Capricorn rising, Venus rules both the 5th and the 10th: pleasures, music, gains from speculation, a proper guru and success.
With Capricorn rising and the Moon ruling the 7th, the native always wants company and works, studies and travels best with a friend.
With Aquarius rising, Jupiter rules the 2nd and the 11th: a good family and a healthy bank balance.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: With Aquarius rising, Venus rules the 4th and the 9th: support from the parents and chances of higher education abroad.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: With Aquarius rising, a planet is in Poorvashada (Venus’s star in Jupiter’s sign, joining the lords of 4-9 and 2-11): the native is fortunate in that planet’s period.
With Aquarius rising, Mars rules the 3rd and the 10th: study and research lead to recognition in work.
With Pisces rising and Mars ruling the 2nd, the native earns freely and spends even more freely.
With Pisces rising and Venus ruling the 3rd, the native has good neighbours and wins them over by generosity.
With Pisces rising and the Moon ruling the 5th, the native’s pleasures turn to music, cinema and the occult, with wandering fancies.
With Pisces rising, Jupiter rules the 1st and the 10th: politics, philosophy, medicine or a high public post suit the native.
With Pisces rising, Saturn rules the 11th and the 12th: Saturn-type friends disappoint, with trouble in Saturn’s sub period.
With Virgo rising and Jupiter ruling the 4th, the native is lucky in getting houses, and property gains value in Jupiter’s period.
With Virgo rising, Saturn rules both the 5th and the 6th: the children are few, and the native may borrow to pay for their needs.
With Virgo rising and Jupiter ruling the 7th, the partner is God-fearing and law-abiding.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): with a fiery sign rising, the native is proud, enterprising and commanding, keen to lead rather than serve, and acts on his own impulses.

Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): with an earthy sign rising, the native is careful, practical and methodical, slow but persevering, and set on wealth and position; earthy signs rising also favour good health.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): movable signs on all four angles: ambition and enterprise, a prominent position in one’s field, a quick grasp and many changes in life.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): fixed signs on all four angles: firm, determined and self-reliant; slow to decide and slow to rise, but success comes in the end through persistence.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): a movable sign on the 2nd cusp: money comes through name, fame and activity; finances fluctuate and speculative ventures are favoured.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): a movable sign on the 3rd cusp: an active, ambitious but changeable mind, fond of change and of much travelling.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): a fixed sign on the 3rd cusp: a firm, persevering, rather rigid mind; the native dislikes travel and travels only when he must.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): a common sign on the 3rd cusp: a receptive, methodical mind, easily affected by its surroundings.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Jupiter in the 11th in a movable sign gives executive ability and steady progress.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Jupiter in the 11th in a fixed sign brings jealousy and pride among friends.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Jupiter in the 11th in a common sign gives friends of a scientific or religious bent, who may prove unreliable.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Saturn in the 11th in a fixed sign brings delay and hindrance through friends.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): Saturn in the 11th with a common sign on its cusp: hopes may go unfulfilled, and friends may bring sorrow.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): the lords of the 1st and 7th have exchanged signs (parivartana): partnership is advisable and a good working arrangement with others is shown.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): the 11th cusp and its lord are both in common signs: friendships of doubtful worth.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): fruitful signs on the 5th and 11th cusps, with the lords of 5 and 11 in fruitful signs, promise children.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): barren signs on the 1st, 5th and 11th cusps, or the lords of these houses in barren signs, lessen the chances of children, if other testimony agrees.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): fruitful signs on the 5th and 7th cusps, with their lords in fruitful signs, point to an early union.
Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): barren signs on the 1st and 5th cusps suggest that marriage may not come in good time, if other testimony agrees.

Tradition (reported by Krishnamurti): a voice sign (Gemini, Libra or Aquarius) on the 2nd cusp with Venus or Mercury in the 2nd gives eloquence or a gift of voice, the more so if that planet is free from affliction.
Rahu is in a star of the Sun, and the Sun rules an evil house (6, 8 or 12): Rahu’s periods bring quarrels, distrust, unrest of mind and changes of job or residence.
Rahu is in a star of the Sun, which rules both a kendra and a trine (a rajayoga lord): Rahu’s periods bring promotion, name and fame, and an end to enmity.
Rahu is in a star of the Moon, which rules no evil house: Rahu’s periods favour income, crops and land, a pleasant life among kin, and sea travel, unless the Moon is afflicted.
Rahu is in a star of the Moon, and the Moon rules an evil house: Rahu’s periods bring worries, transfers and changes of residence.

Rahu is in a star of Mars: its periods tend to bring disputes, losses through theft or lawsuits, rash acts and trouble with officials. If Mars is a benefic in the chart, the results are agreeable instead.
Rahu is in a star of Mercury, which rules no evil house: its periods bring many friends and helpers, travel, earnings in several ways, savings, children, a vehicle and gain through agency.
Rahu is in a star of Mercury, and Mercury rules an evil house: the native is tempted to break promises and deceive, and so makes enemies.
Rahu is in a star of Jupiter, which rules no evil house: its periods end enmity and bring success in elections and lawsuits, wealth, children, position through people in power, and pilgrimage.
Rahu is in a star of Venus, which rules no evil house: its periods bring vehicles and fine things, wealth, promotion, popularity, marriage and children.
Rahu is in a star of Venus, and Venus rules an evil house: the native is open to deception, enmity, scandal through the other sex and loss of money and honour.
Rahu is in a star of Saturn: its periods bring disputes, misunderstanding with the partner (even separation), ill-repute, and a move to a remote, quiet place.

Rahu is in its own star (Arudra, Swathi or Sathabhisha): its periods bring anxiety, petty quarrels and scandal; but if Rahu is in the sub of a benefic, the native heads the family, gains promotion and travels abroad.

Rahu is in a star of Ketu: its periods bring confusion, losses and trouble through the partner and superiors; if Ketu is well placed, they bring jewels, marriage, promotion, a building or a car instead.
Ketu is in a star of the Sun: its periods bring setbacks in work, friction with superiors, adverse orders from authority, separation from family and losses in speculation.
Ketu is in a star of the Moon, which rules no evil house: its periods bring both social and financial success.
Ketu is in a star of the Moon, and the Moon rules an evil house: its periods bring low spirits, disputes, worry through the women of the family, and loss of money.
Ketu is in a star of Mars: its periods bring rash acts, disputes with brothers, partition and trouble over land; if Mars is a benefic by lordship, they bring marriage and a house instead.
Ketu is in a star of Mercury: its periods end troubles and bring reunion, good friends, learning and training, long travel, marriage, contracts and a pleasant new phase of life.
Ketu is in a star of Jupiter: its periods bring freedom from debt, earnings, a sound bank position, children, profitable dealings, success and marriage.
Ketu is in a star of Venus: its periods bring comfort, a good, well furnished home, more income, higher status, a vehicle and the release of pledged goods.
Ketu is in a star of Saturn: its periods bring loss of money and property, trouble from enemies, disputes with relatives and the landlord, and changes of residence.
Ketu is in a star of Rahu: its periods bring sale of possessions, lawsuits, quarrels with friends, setbacks at work and loss of prestige.
Ketu is in its own star (Aswini, Makam or Moolam): its periods bring confusion, worry, loss, delay and separation, though less so if Ketu is in a good house with its lord well placed.

rules.topic: Father, fortune, higher learning and abroad
rules.text: Jupiter or the lord of the 9th is in the lagna or with the Moon. In Krishnamurti’s account of karma, the native carries only light faults from past births and enjoys life without needing remedies (shanti).
Saturn and Ketu share a sign. Krishnamurti says that whenever these two join, trouble follows.

Tradition holds that the sex of a coming child can be read from the parent’s birth chart; Krishnamurti rejects this, because one moment of birth can give twins of different sex. Do not trust such natal readings.
Jupiter and Venus share a sign. Tradition calls them enemies; Krishnamurti rejects this because their conjunction brings prosperity. The “enmity” only means opposite aims in life.

Tradition gives Rahu and Ketu signs of ownership and exaltation; Krishnamurti rejects this because the authorities contradict each other. The nodes own no sign and act as agents of the planets they are linked with.
Tradition holds that Mercury within 17° of the Sun (combust) loses its power; Krishnamurti doubts this, because many able people with Mercury close to the Sun rose in Mercury–Sun periods.
